detail_observations.text:
Quest Dialogue
Master Fhungusu tells you, "I have been waiting for you, <insert character's name here>.
"I am here to kill you, Master Fhungusu."
Master Fhungusu tells you, "I know this , <insert character's name here. As disappointing as it may be, you will not be killing me today."
"Fool, who do you think you're dealing with?"
Master Fhungusu tells you, "I know who you are, <insert character's name here>. You follow orders mindlessly and slay innocent people. It is time for this to stop."
"I am a servant of the Emperor."
Master Fhungusu tells you, "But your service to the Emperor has caused the death of many innocent people. I can see guilt in your eyes, do you not feel it?"
"There is no turning back now, Master Fhungusu."
Master Fhungusu tells you, "We both know that this life of treachery must end. It is time for your transformation. It is time for you to be born again."
"What do you propose, Master Fhungusu?"
Master Fhungusu tells you, "I will wipe the blood from your hands, your new life and the path towards Jin starts now."
<End of Dialogue>
Master Fhungusus casts a spell and you are teleported to Dallerjuba Village.

findings.observation: Both level-2 quest pages name Imperial Officer Yu as starter and show Previous The Monks Of Shang Village and Next Redemption. Navigation is not evidence of enforced prerequisites. The two quest URLs remain distinct source variants.

The first page objective says Confront Master Fhungusu; the Quest-suffixed page includes an instruction to slay him. Both narrative accounts instead describe speaking and teleportation. Literal instructions remain separate from demonstrated completion mechanics.

The first page Hand in to field names Imperial Officer Yu and reports one ends-npc disagreement. The Quest-suffixed page notes completion with Celinal and attributes finishing dialogue to Celinal. This turn-in collision is withheld rather than resolved.
The first page records location 10195, -6661, 2185. The Quest-suffixed page records 9950, -6943, 2116 in Shang Village (-20, 13). Neither is promoted to an exact target spawn.

First page attributes offering and carrying dialogue to vg.curse.com and links the emulator MMODB archive; the other attributes dialogue to Fandom. These are cached archive transcriptions, not independently fetched corroboration. Teleport destination Dallerjuba village is a narrative claim, not verified transport coordinates.

Both pages preserve the warning about following orders and slaying innocent people, also present in the separately reviewed mob speech. Text overlap does not establish a canonical mob-to-quest identity. Coin reward 20 appears only on the Quest-suffixed page without denomination. Absent reward fields on the other page do not establish zero rewards.
